explore_prose: Every run in this experiment is in the explorer below: filter by outcome to see which settings held the SLOs, or by setting to compare one sweep against another.
Each sweep's hypothesis was written before the runs, and is quoted beside that sweep's measured result below.

hero.html: 51 configurations over 7 sweeps (colocated, colocated-tuned, pd-ratio, pd-always, pd-wide-decode, pd-pool-engine, pd-decode-cudagraph), each at 4 load levels, every run on exactly 64 GPUs.
8x TP8 + EP, from the colocated sweep, reached 15.4 tok/s/accelerator (985.4 tok/s across the fleet) at concurrency 128 while holding the scenario's SLOs.
8x TP8 + EP at concurrency 128. 204 of 204 runs held the SLOs.

meta: deterministic sweep — no LLM in the measurement path
recommendation_prose: The table below ranks the measured operating points by output tok/s per accelerator, the objective this experiment selects on, among runs that held the scenario's SLOs.

prose: Eight single-node TP8 instances should lead, since wider dp groups pay cross-node IB all-to-all for little extra batch.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP at 15.4 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: colocated

prose: A bigger token budget with a long-prefill cap should hold ITL to higher load, narrowing what P/D can win.
Measured: best was 8x TP8 + EP at 15.4 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: colocated-tuned

prose: Decode-heavy ratios should win on AgentX, since cached prefixes leave only a short uncached tail to prefill per turn.
Measured: best was 4P/4D TP8 + EP at 11.47 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-ratio

prose: Splitting every request should trail the threshold arms, because a turn with a cached prefix pays an IB handoff for little prefill.
Measured: best was 4P/4D TP8 + EP at 11.13 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-always

prose: TP16 decode instances should hold ITL at higher load than TP8 ones, trading batch slots for faster steps.
Measured: best was 4P/2D TP8 + EP at 12.89 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-wide-decode

prose: A 32k prefill budget should matter on the prefill-light layout and a decode-pool prefill cap on the decode-heavy one.
Measured: best was 4P/4D TP8 + EP at 11.76 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-pool-engine

prose: Full graph capture on the decode pool should lower ITL by a few percent, with FULL_DECODE_ONLY matching FULL there.
Measured: best was 3P/5D TP8 + EP at 8.72 tok/s/accelerator (concurrency 128).
sections.title: Sweep: pd-decode-cudagraph
